goal.title: Apply fictional archive circulation rules
goal.learningTarget: Determine valid item loans and renewals from stated eligibility, hold, and return rules
goal.questionDirective: Write five distinct, self-contained multiple-choice cases about fictional archive circulation. State every needed loan period, time convention, membership condition, hold rule, and all other premises inside each item. Require one and only one correct answer. Make each incorrect choice fail one identifiable stated rule; explain the correct choice and every rejection accurately. Do not reuse a scenario or correct-answer mechanism within these five items. Assume no outside domain knowledge.
